text: My office heard from school administrators at Gordon A. Brown Middle School regarding conflicting signage in their pick-up/drop-off area located on Selwyn Avenue. In order to correct this discrepancy, I recommend amending the existing parking prohibitions on Selwyn Avenue to the following.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 6:00 p.m. of one day to 8:00 a.m. of the next following day, Monday to Friday, and anytime, Saturday and Sunday, on the east side of Selwyn Avenue, between a point 38 metres north of St. Clair Avenue East and Dalecrest Drive, to be in effect from 6:00 p.m. of one day to 7:30 a.m. of the next following day, Monday to Friday, and anytime, Saturday and Sunday. 2. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the east side of Selwyn Avenue, between St. Clair Avenue East and a point 38 metres north.
